subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dc86777e54200d7bb43a4171852a1c15a3d2b3eafa2f9ca076d0af4cbf9b15a.png]
solution:
The logic follows here is:

Step I: The triangles are getting blank and shaded alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c35629a778b1badc6d7c6deddfd0568ac694e8cdab97c456691e616bda72ba6.png] 

Step II: The dark circles are getting shifted by + 1 places to each next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f04230ebb1bee0f69df7b16b573c6975f2b5519ffa5a375bec36472f2a659d90.png] 

So, **'Option 4'** will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
